# NORMALISATION: CRLF->LF, trailing whitespace stripped per line; leading indentation KEPT; ⭐ COMMENTS ARE KEPT AND COUNT — a whitespace-only diff is NOT a row, a changed comment IS a row.
# DELIMITER: luafn.find_bodies, imported not re-implemented. Keys collapse `Class:Method` and `Class.Method`; the separator actually written is the first character of the sig columns.

# COVERAGE (v1.1): indent-0 declarations, five forms (function C:M / function C.M / function G / local function f / [local] x = function), PLUS every INDENTED declaration of those forms that lies OUTSIDE every enumerated span — table-field methods, sequence `Run = function(seq_state)` steps, file-level nested locals — keyed `name@<anchor>` and flagged INDENTED (ONE-LINE when the declaration closes itself: that row hashes its own line only, deliberately, so a neighbour's edit cannot re-hash it; the indent-0 pass keeps the delimiter's over-span untouched, checklist 135). Indented declarations INSIDE an enumerated span are covered by the outer body's hash and not listed. Orphans on the 1.1.0 side: 1050 in `hand` files, 1885 in `generated` (613 one-line); 1377 identical across the trees, 1910 rows. Total indented declarations for comparison: 8473 (4883 hand, 3590 generated). STILL NOT COVERED: every anonymous `function(` literal passed as an argument. ⛔ A function never emitted is not a function that did not change.

# FILES: changed=2437 identical=1963 added=166 removed=36 (DLC/ excluded: 151 paths). ⭐ MANIFEST RE-DERIVATION CONTROL vs chain README §0 (which counts DLC): 2437+7=2444 changed, 1963+5=1968 identical, 166+139=305 added, 36+0=36 removed — MATCHES; the 139 DLC adds are 138 `DLC/norman` + 1 `DLC/thomas`.

Rejected as too trivial to be evidence: 706 added rows (bodies like `end` or `return true`); rejected as ambiguous (one body, many partners): 0. Those are NOT `no match` — they are `too generic to say`.

# 02 COLUMNS: rid = R + 1-based data-row index of INVENTORY.tsv (stable while 01's file is). system = the BINDING partition (02 brief §2.A); link = 03 | 04-A turf | 04-B colony | 04-C engine | 04-D removed/added+storage | 04-E presets — dlc-adjacent overrides every system (disjoint by construction). system_rule = the rule that fired (path / class prefix / basename / hand: <reason>). dlc_terms = the APPLIED match (T1 literal, T2~ narrowed); dlc_literal = every literal hit of all 25 brief terms, applied or not — ⛔ an untagged row with dlc_literal is 04's, and a seam 04 finds there is a note to 03.

# 02 DLC TAG (unit B), a stated DEVIATION from the brief's literal list: T1 = Food Meal Crop Farm Fungal Bakery Replicator Restaurant Insect Animal Hunger Starv Consumption FoodService norman thomas IsDlcAvailable AssemblyOfPlanets LawOffice ServiceBuilding, LITERAL substring, + the 51 class/global names declared in DLC/norman/Code + DLC/thomas/Code (word-bounded); T2 = Tech Resource Law Policy Cargo in their QUALIFIED sense only (registry/walk forms, word-bounded). Literal matching of all 25 would tag 2,918 rows (8,209 readable preset rows) and fence them off from 04 while 03 cannot hold them — over-tagging makes rows UNREAD, under-tagging leaves them with 04. Text matched: the 1.1.0 body (1.0.7 body for removed rows) + both signatures.

# 02 FAN-OUT (unit C): class/change/seam/guard/verdict/smell come from a judgement agent that read BOTH bodies (batch + round in triage_note, brief hash in TRIAGE.md §2). `*` classes (e.g. (f)*) are MECHANICAL by kind, not read. ⛔ A CHURN verdict is an agent's claim, UNREAD by anyone else; a SMELL is a PASSING candidate for the owning link to derive, not a finding; no row here is a defect.

# 02 FIELD-REPORT TAGS (README §2b, owner 2026-09-10), column `fr`, BY FUNCTION: FR-1(a) = entry functions on the New Game -> first sol path (OnMsg NewGame/NewMap*/CityStart/ChangeMapDone/MapGen*, RandomMapGenerator.*, MapGen.*, StartNewGame, InitNewGameMissionParams, City/Colony Init*, Create/Change/Switch/Init/SetupMap*, PreGameMission.lua Start/Launch/Begin/NewGame/Apply/Init functions) + ONE HOP of changed callees (text-level; a callee name declared by >3 changed rows is not followed); FR-1(b) = an FR-1 row branching on IsDlcAvailable/norman -> link 03; FR-1(c) = CommonLua/Classes/Lightmodel.lua + RenderFeaturesParams* rows + bodies naming upscaler/DLSS/XeSS/FSR/AA; FR-1(d) = a changed line assigning hr.*; FR-2 = deep-scan/probe/exploration/reveal/subsurface names or deep-scan body terms + one hop; FR-3 = an ADDED or CHANGED line creating/shortening periodic work (Create*Thread, *Repeat, Sleep, WaitMsg, WaitWakeup, DelayedCall) or a new high-frequency OnMsg handler. ⛔ An FR tag does not move a row out of its system (except FR-1(b)); it orders the reading. A tag is a surface, not a cause.
